news.title: STRONGHOLD PROTOCOL: ALLIANCE OPEN
lines: DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain event rewards by leveling up [Stronghold Credit] with [Stronghold Credits], which can be earned by clearing event stages, completing [Key Objectives] missions and Daily Goal; In addition, this update improves the experience of Solo Simulation and Team Simulation, while also introducing new difficulties, Alliances, Strategies, and more.
REWARDS: MARTHE Sports Line - Hydration Time for Mousse, Event Icon 'Restarting Simulation!', Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, etc.

- Solo Simulation optimization: Rest Phases and Improv Phases are no longer time-limited; you may leave partway through and return within 24 hours to continue the simulation. In addition, the Round Count required for Standard Simulations has been reduced.

- Team Simulation optimization: You can now start simulations with fewer than 4 players. The unlock states of Simulation are now shared between Solo Simulation and Team Simulation, and a new higher difficulty level, [Ultimate Simulation], has been added.
- Preset Operator optimization: All 4★, 5★, and event-gifted 6★ Operators can now be used directly, even if not owned.
- Interaction optimization: Equipment can now be equipped directly to Operators on the Bench, and Operators on the Bench and in the Battle Zone can be swapped even when the Bench is full.
- Combat optimization: The mechanics of certain enemy leaders have been adjusted, and the ATK of some enemies has been reduced.
In addition, this update will introduce new Alliances, Strategies, Preset Operators, Equipment, maps, and enemies, along with balance adjustments to some existing content.

- Daily Goal: Players can obtain [Stronghold Credits] every day through Simulation. Once reached a certain amount, a bonus [Stronghold Credits] reward will be available at the completion screen. This reward can be claimed once per day, refreshing daily at 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Some Rerun Outfits will return to the Outfit Store from August 20, 08:00 to September 10, 03:59 (UTC-7). Please refer to the in-game Outfit Store for details.
